rules.rule: Do not make fal.ai calls until King says to resume fal work.
Do not start a full video run until King gives his go-ahead.
Estimate image generation cost before running it, per CLAUDE.md.
When committing in a private project's own repo, commit only the episode folder that belongs to you.
To build the SYSTEM hive used by the ramdisk, run `ninja boot/bootdata/system`, not `ninja bootcd_hives`.
Do not create git commits without first asking the user for permission.
Before starting any IO subsystem translation work, check the IO translation status file.
When using the Unix socket serial client, listen on the socket before starting QEMU (server-socket pattern).
Do not modify plugin cache files to fix agent model configuration.
Do not modify .claude/settings.json to fix agent model configuration.
Do not modify CLAUDE.md to fix agent model configuration; use the memory layer instead.
Edit project skills in `.agents/skills/`, not in the generated `.claude/skills/` mirror.
Before running `kubectl delete application <name> -n argocd`, always confirm with the user first.
Edit `MEMORY.md` directly at `/workspaces/home-ops/.claude/memory/MEMORY.md`, not through the symlinked path.
If a memory file in `~/.claude/projects/-workspaces-home-ops/memory/` is a real file, move it to `/workspaces/home-ops/.claude/memory/`.
Never commit the Thread network key or PSKc to the repository.
Never edit /data/settings.json in Music Assistant while MA is running.
Run kubectl get, describe, logs, top, and diff freely without asking for confirmation.
Ask the user for confirmation before running kubectl apply, delete, patch, rollout restart, or exec.
Run talosctl get, health, logs, version, dmesg, ps, services, and disks freely without asking for confirmation.
Ask the user for confirmation before running talosctl apply-config, upgrade, reset, reboot, or shutdown.
Run terraform show, plan, and state freely without asking for confirmation, in provision/terraform/cloudflare/.
Ask the user for confirmation before running terraform apply, destroy, taint, or import in provision/terraform/cloudflare/.
Run argocd app list, get, and diff freely without asking for confirmation.
Ask the user for confirmation before running argocd app sync, delete, or set.
Committing on the feature branch is allowed.
Never merge a PR without fresh consent from the user.
Always render the Helm/Kustomize manifests before committing Helm/Kustomize changes.
Before creating a templates/httproute.yaml file, run helm show values on the chart to check for built-in gateway/HTTPRoute support.
Keep superpowers-era specs and plans in `.archive/.plans/superpowers/{specs,plans,research}/`; do not move them out.
Do not recreate `.plans/superpowers/`.
Update VERSION_NAME in main.c as part of every commit.
Stop and ask the user before merging PRs.
Never merge a pull request by any method, including `gh pr merge`, unless the user explicitly tells you to merge.
When deleting temporary space, delete that exact absolute path rather than using a wildcard or a relative path.
Before merging a worker's PR, the controller must verify the PASS claim independently rather than trusting the worker's report.
Keep the .mcp.json file untracked (do not commit it to version control).
Compact the Windows vhdx (which requires `wsl --shutdown`) only with the owner's OK.
Compact the Windows vhdx (which requires `wsl --shutdown`) only when no hook is running.
Never merge the PR yourself; leave review and merging to the user.
Never ask the user for permission before opening the PR.
Run `git branch -D` only after verifying that the branch tip equals the merged PR head, and perform that check as its own separate step.
For a change that touches only proposals, plans, docs, `.claude/`, `memory/` or root Markdown, do not run tests, typecheck, lint, or `pnpm verify`, and do not wait on or report them.
Before running any `git commit`, verify the current branch is not `main`.
Run the staging corpus loader as a one-off container on the noorinalabs_backend docker network on the staging host (ssh deploy@noorinalabs-stg), since no bolt port is published.
Do not run production corpus loads without explicit owner approval.
Staging corpus loads are permitted as sanctioned wave work.
Gate thaqalayn parser fixes on passing `make validate` in strict mode.
For fast stage rehearsal, use scripts/scrub_relational_pollution.py on already-built curated artifacts instead of re-running the full NER→disambiguate→enrichment pipeline.
When resuming dedup, reload the persisted .faiss index instead of rebuilding it.
